draft.label: Model-internal: asked a model, got agreement.
Secondary document: summary, aggregator, abstract, plain-language version.
Primary source, located: the specific part that decides the claim.
A person with standing who disagreed, or who could have and did not.

structural_predicates.rung_3_and_above: The claim has an outbound provenance edge to a node that carries a non-empty url and a retrieved_at.
structural_predicates.rung_4_and_above: As rung 3, and the source node also carries a locator that names the deciding part (page, section, DOI, clause).
structural_predicates.rung_5: The claim has an edge to a person node that records standing and a disagreement, or a recorded chance to disagree that was not taken.
